findings.highlight: Kiritsugu made a long, contented sigh, and whispered,
findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮切嗣はそうか、と長く息を吸って、
findings.governingReading: Kiritsugu says 'I see,' takes a long breath in, then says he is relieved.
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu's long inhalation becomes a contented sigh.

findings.highlight: On a winter night, the man I called my father looked up at the moon and entered a long sleep.
findings.evidenceJa: 何をするでもなく、冬の月と、長い眠りに入った、父親だった人を見上げていた。
findings.governingReading: The child silently looks up at the winter moon and the man who had been his father, now entered into a long sleep.
findings.explanation: Shirou looking at his dead father becomes Kiritsugu looking at the moon.

findings.highlight: That's who he wanted to be, and he passed his wish on to me before quietly letting the curtain fall.
findings.evidenceJa: その彼こそが“そういうモノ”に成りたかったと遺して、自分の前で穏やかに幕を閉じた。
findings.governingReading: Kiritsugu leaves behind the admission that he himself wanted to become such a thing, then quietly ends his life before Shirou.
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu's dying statement becomes an intentional bequest to Shirou.

findings.highlight: What did Kiritsugu mean by doing the right thing and championing justice? How can I grow up faster? Is there some magical way to make Kiritsugu's dream of 'making everyone happy' come true? Seriously, what am I supposed do when I become a Master and I can't get the blonde girl with me out of my head—
findings.evidenceJa: 切嗣の言っていた正義の味方ってどんなモノなのかとか、早く一人前になる方法とか、切嗣の口癖だったみんなが幸せでいられればいい、なんて魔法みたいな夢の実現方法とか、それと、マスターなんてモノになっちまって、一緒に付いてきた金髪の女の子とか頭んなかがゴチャゴチャだ、ホント—
findings.governingReading: Already a Master, Shirou says his head is a jumble of the justice ideal, growing up, making everyone happy, and the blond girl who came with him.
findings.explanation: Shirou's confused inventory becomes a future Master problem and romantic fixation.

findings.highlight: My body feels sluggish, and my insides seem to churn whenever I move. I imagine this is about what it'd feel like if someone forced hot lead down my throat.
findings.evidenceJa: 体は重いし、動く度に腹ん中がぐるんぐるんと回るよう。きっと胃に焼けた鉛を流し込んだら、こんな気分になるのではあるまいか。
findings.governingReading: Shirou compares the churning inside his abdomen to having molten lead poured into his stomach.
findings.explanation: Molten lead poured into the stomach becomes hot lead forced down the throat.

findings.highlight: I should've died instantly.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺、ほぼ即死だった筈じゃないか？
findings.governingReading: Shirou believes he should have been almost instantly dead.
findings.explanation: Near-instant death becomes unqualified instant death.

findings.highlight: "Yeah. I figured you wouldn't take risks or really do much if you knew defeat meant death. But it looks like you're the kind of person to go out at night even in a situation like this.
findings.evidenceJa: 「そうよ。負ける事がそのまま死に繋がるって知れば、そう簡単に博打は打たなくなる。衛宮くん、こういう状況でも一人で夜出歩きそうだから。
findings.governingReading: Rin hoped that knowing defeat directly meant death would keep Shirou from readily taking such gambles.
findings.explanation: Rin's plan to deter gambling with death becomes a plan to keep Shirou from doing much at all.

findings.highlight: Afterwards, my body started to heal on its own, and was back to normal after a few minutes.
findings.evidenceJa: その後、よく見れば俺の体は勝手に治りはじめ、十分もしたら外見は元通りになった。
findings.governingReading: After about ten minutes of spontaneous healing, Shirou's outward appearance had returned to normal.
findings.explanation: Ten minutes becomes a few minutes.

findings.highlight: I was still unconscious, so Tohsaka brought me here and the rest was as I remember it.
findings.evidenceJa: 傷は治ったものの意識が戻らない俺をここまで運んで、あとは今に至るという訳だとか。
findings.governingReading: Rin carried the still-unconscious Shirou home, and that sequence brings the account to the present.
findings.explanation: The account reaching the present becomes something unconscious Shirou remembers.

findings.highlight: "No way. I can't revive someone on the verge of death. What was I supposed to do about your intestines scattered on the pavement?"
findings.evidenceJa: 「まさか。死にかけてる人間を蘇生させる、なんて芸当は、もうわたしには出来ない。衛宮士郎は自分でぶっ飛んだ中身をどうにかしたのよ」
findings.governingReading: Rin says she can no longer perform the feat of reviving someone near death; Shirou himself somehow dealt with his scattered insides.
findings.explanation: Shirou's self-repair becomes Rin asking what she could have done.

findings.highlight: You might have survived this time, but you might not live to tell the tale next time you get hurt like last night. It's probably best you just ditch the notion that any small wounds will heal on their own."
findings.evidenceJa: 今回は助かったからいいけど、次にあんな傷を負ったらまず助からない筈だから。多少の傷なら治る、なんていう甘い考えは捨てた方がいいでしょうね」
findings.governingReading: Rin warns that if Shirou receives another wound like that, he almost certainly should not survive.
findings.explanation: An almost-certain fatal prognosis becomes mere possibility.

findings.highlight: "I know. Saber had to help me because I went and got myself hurt. I don't have any excuses for that."
findings.evidenceJa: 「分かってる。俺がかってにケガして、それでセイバーから何かを貰ってる、なんていうのは申し訳ない」
findings.governingReading: He apologizes that when he gets hurt on his own, he receives or takes something from Saber.
findings.explanation: Shirou's concern about taking something from Saber becomes generic help and excuse-making.

findings.highlight: More than anything, I want to avoid any killing.
findings.evidenceJa: 殺し合いは出来れば避けたいし、何より—
findings.governingReading: Shirou says he would prefer to avoid killing each other, and above all—then breaks off before naming his overriding concern.
findings.explanation: The unfinished bridge to Shirou's paramount concern is closed as a completed ranking of killing.

findings.highlight: The Servants have wishes of their own. That's why they respond to summons that would otherwise be, at best, unreasonable."
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントたちにもね、それぞれ何らかの欲望があるのよ。だからこそ彼等は本来有り得ない召喚に応じている」
findings.governingReading: Rin says Servants answer a summoning which by nature should not be possible because they each have a desire.
findings.explanation: An inherently impossible summoning becomes merely unreasonable.

findings.highlight: When people die to an invisible killer, those deaths will just be treated as accidents or natural causes.
findings.evidenceJa: 姿のない殺戮者に襲われた人間の死は、事故死か自殺としか扱われまい。
findings.governingReading: Deaths caused by an invisible killer would be treated only as accidents or suicides.
findings.explanation: Suicide as an apparent cause of death becomes natural causes.

findings.highlight: Like how there are different guns—pistols, rifles, shotguns— mages all have a variety of abilities.
findings.evidenceJa: 銃の種類は短銃、ライフル銃、マシンガン、ショットガンと、魔術師ごとに性能が異なる。
findings.governingReading: Shirou distinguishes pistols, rifles, machine guns and shotguns as different mage performance types.
findings.explanation: The firearm analogy drops machine guns.

findings.highlight: Bluntly speaking, inferior Masters have to feed other people to their Servants."
findings.evidenceJa: はっきり言ってしまえばね、実力のないマスターは、サーヴァントに人を食わせるのよ」
findings.governingReading: Rin bluntly says unskilled Masters feed people to their Servants.
findings.explanation: Weak Masters choosing to feed people to Servants becomes a necessity.

findings.highlight: Conversely, if the other Masters know who you are, you're just asking to be ambushed.
findings.evidenceJa: 逆に誰がマスターかを知っていれば、確実に奇襲ができる。
findings.governingReading: Conversely, if a Master knows who another Master is, that Master can certainly launch a surprise attack.
findings.explanation: Knowing another Master's identity as an offensive advantage becomes one's own exposure.

findings.highlight: "Yeah. I know they're just pretty words. But I can't think of anything else. I'm not changing my principles, no matter what you say."
findings.evidenceJa: 「ああ、都合がいいのは分かってる。けど、それ以外の方針は考えつかない。こればっかりはどんなに言われても変えないからな」
findings.governingReading: Shirou knows his policy is convenient for himself or selectively favorable, yet cannot devise another and refuses to change it.
findings.explanation: Shirou admits his policy is self-serving, but the English calls it pretty words.

findings.highlight: But I promised to listen, so I need to hear her out.
findings.evidenceJa: が、男が断言した以上、聞かない訳にもいかないのだ。
findings.governingReading: Having made such a firm declaration as a man, Shirou feels he cannot refuse to hear the problem Rin raises.
findings.explanation: A categorical declaration obliging Shirou to hear Rin out becomes a promise to listen.

findings.highlight: "Not in a straight-up fight. That's the ultimate close-quarters Servant. There probably isn't anyone who can match it even among all the heroes of myth and legend. If Berserker attacks me, there's no escape."
findings.evidenceJa: 「正面からじゃ勝てないでしょうね。白兵戦ならアレは最強のサーヴァントよ。きっと歴代のサーヴァントの中でも、アレと並ぶヤツはいないと思う。わたしもバーサーカーに襲われたら逃げ延びる手段はないわ」
findings.governingReading: Rin thinks no one in the history of Servants likely equals Berserker in close combat.
findings.explanation: Berserker's standing among summoned Servants becomes standing among every legendary hero.

findings.highlight: "Yeah. My Archer's still recovering from a serious wound. That's going to take some time, but in the meantime, I'm not completely out of the fight.
findings.evidenceJa: 「そう。わたしのアーチャーは致命傷を受けて目下治療中。完全に回復するまで時間がかかるけど、それでも半人前ぐらいの活躍はできる筈よ。
findings.governingReading: Although full recovery will take time, Rin expects Archer can still perform at roughly half-fledged capacity.
findings.explanation: Archer's expected half-capacity during recovery becomes only Rin remaining in the fight.

findings.highlight: And while your Servant is superb, her Master's dragging her down, making her half as effective. See? Put the two of us together and you've got a whole."
findings.evidenceJa: で、そっちはサーヴァントは申し分ないけど、マスターが足ひっぱってやっぱり半人前。ほら、合わせれば丁度いいわ」
findings.governingReading: Saber is faultless, but her Master drags the side down, leaving their unit half-fledged.
findings.explanation: The Shirou–Saber team being half-fledged becomes Saber herself half as effective.

findings.highlight: "I'll make it worth your while. I'll let you off for getting Archer hurt, and teach you what you need to know to be a Master. Oh, and if we have time, I can even give you some pointers on your magecraft. Deal?"
findings.evidenceJa: 「同盟の代価ぐらいは払うわ。アーチャーを倒されたコトはチャラにしてあげて、マスターとしての知識も教えてあげる。ああ、あと暇があれば衛宮くんの魔術の腕を見てあげてもいいけど、どう？」
findings.governingReading: Rin offers to wipe the slate clean over Archer having been defeated and to teach Shirou Master knowledge.
findings.explanation: Archer's defeat becomes merely being hurt.

findings.highlight: I know next to nothing, and Tohsaka does seem knowledgeable.
findings.evidenceJa: 右も左も分からない俺にとって、遠坂は頼りになる先輩だ。
findings.governingReading: For Shirou, who knows neither right nor left, Rin is a dependable senior he can rely on.
findings.explanation: A reliable senior relationship becomes a bare judgment that Rin seems knowledgeable.
